about: QI isles first-ten-minutes gate 2 (NEXT-SLICES-3): every island from a fresh profile at 390x844 touch. Simulated time (fixed 1/30 s steps through __isles.step, the page clock advanced by the same dt). targets = the QI acceptance numbers. knownIssues = the measured value on the base branch for a target the game misses today (assert: not worse than this baseline, null = never happened; print the gap).

knownIssues._notes: Measured on claude/animal-crossing-game-7z3roh @ 67cc086 (3 identical runs: the sim is deterministic). layout.tinyText 5 on every island: the Craft panel's recipe notes (.rc-note) are 11 px. maxRewardGap: long walks between glints after the nearby ones are picked (glints regrow after 180-600 s) with nothing tameable from the starter pouch on home / reef / mars (their diets - clover, kelp, fish, oxide dust, iron - never enter the pouch; only jungle_berry / raw_meat / bug do). deaths: no HP regeneration on the isles (only a respawn heals), so hostiles (jungle raptors, tundra rimewolf / sabrefang, mars at 1 HP after an air run) take a careful bot down over 10 minutes. tundra-b: the first tame (rimewolf knockout) comes at 315 s. reach.marsReachable: the Craft panel lists only CRAFT.IDS (no rocket_core_drift; the iron rocket core needs mars iron), and __isles.craft('rocket_core_drift') makes a rocket core but does not add mars to `unlock` (UNLOCK_BY_ITEM is keyed by recipe id): waits on XW1.
